definitions.explanation: Describes progress, development, or achievement that is impressively rapid or outstanding. Literally suggests something so impressive that it 'wakes the eyes.' Almost always used in a positive sense.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざま}ましい{成長|せいちょう}を{遂|と}げた。
AIの{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{目覚|めざま}ましい{進歩|しんぽ}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: AI technology continues to make remarkable progress.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{入社|にゅうしゃ}してからわずか{三年|さんねん}で{目覚|めざま}ましい{活躍|かつやく}を{見|み}せている。
examples.english: In just three years since joining the company, she has shown spectacular performance.

notes:
USAGE:
An い-adjective. Conjugates regularly: {目覚|めざま}ましくない (negative), {目覚|めざま}ましかった (past), {目覚|めざま}ましく (adverbial). Almost exclusively used to describe positive developments, progress, or achievements.
Implies that the speed or scale of something is eye-opening and impressive. Most naturally modifies words like {発展|はってん} (development), {進歩|しんぽ} (progress), {成長|せいちょう} (growth), and {活躍|かつやく} (active performance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目覚|めざま}ましい{発展|はってん}: remarkable development
- {目覚|めざま}ましい{進歩|しんぽ}: striking progress
- {目覚|めざま}ましい{成長|せいちょう}: spectacular growth
- {目覚|めざま}ましい{活躍|かつやく}: outstanding performance
- {目覚|めざま}ましい{成果|せいか}: remarkable results
